title: My Linux story: Learning Linux in the 90s
author: Mike Harris

selection.start: Most people probably don't remember where they, the computing industry, or the everyday world were in 1996.
selection.end: I ended up choosing Slackware 3.1 as my preferred distribution, probably more because of the terminal's appearance than the other, more important reasons one should consider before deciding on a distribution.
